title: plan-preflight hardening: gitignore cam-plan-out logs + emit plan-preflight-failed event (subsume CAM-159)
description: Guarda-chuva de robustez do plan pre-flight, subsumindo CAM-159. Duas correcoes vistas dogfoodando CAM-121 (um cam plan haltou silencioso). (1) GITIGNORE: runPlanPhase escreve .claude/cam-plan-out-{planner,auditor}-<uuid>.log (pipe-pane do stdout do worker-pane); ship --finalize nao os git-rm; o .gitignore cobre .cam-worker-out-*.log mas NAO cam-plan-out-*. Efeito: git status --porcelain nao-vazio -> runPlanPreflight step clean-tree falha -> proximo cam plan halta sem spawnar planner. FIX: adicionar .claude/cam-plan-out-*.log ao .gitignore (espelhar .cam-worker-out-*.log, CAM-68). (2) OBSERVABILIDADE (ex-CAM-159): quando preflightFn retorna {ok:false,step,detail} dentro de runPlanPhase (plan-runner.ts:519), nenhum evento e emitido em cam-worker-events.jsonl; o operador nao distingue 'preflight barrou' de 'nada aconteceu'. FIX: emitir kind:'plan-preflight-failed' detail:{step,detail} via o logEvent ja presente, na paridade com sidecar-exit/spawn-resolution; estender a union WorkerEventKind (fechada). runPlanPreflight e funcao pura: nao emitir de dentro dela. P2.

acceptanceCriteria: `.gitignore` contains a pattern matching `.claude/cam-plan-out-planner-<uuid>.log` and `.claude/cam-plan-out-auditor-<uuid>.log`, mirroring the existing `.claude/.cam-worker-out-*.log` convention (CAM-68).
With such a file present in `.claude/`, `git status --porcelain` produces no output (test: create the file and assert empty porcelain, or assert the ignore rule via `git check-ignore`).

When runPlanPhase's preflightFn returns {ok:false, step, detail}, a `plan-preflight-failed` event is emitted via the existing logEvent sink with detail:{step, detail} BEFORE the {kind:'preflight-failed'} return; verified by a unit test injecting a failing preflightFn and a fake logEvent asserting the event is logged with the right step.
When preflightFn returns {ok:true}, no `plan-preflight-failed` event is emitted (negative test).
`bun run check:all` green (typecheck + biome + tests); no `--no-verify`.
spec.scope: Two robustness fixes to the plan pre-flight path, both surfaced dogfooding CAM-121 (a cam plan halted silently). (1) Add `.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log` to .gitignore so the planner/auditor pipe-pane logs (cam-plan-out-{planner,auditor}-<uuid>.log, written by runPlanPhase) stop leaving untracked files that make `git status --porcelain` non-empty and trip the clean-tree preflight step. (2) Emit a `plan-preflight-failed` WorkerEvent when runPlanPhase's preflightFn returns ok:false, at parity with the existing sidecar-exit / spawn-resolution events, so the operator can distinguish 'preflight blocked' from 'nothing happened'. In-scope: the .gitignore line, the event emit inside runPlanPhase at the detection point (~line 519) reusing the already-wired logEvent, and adding the new kind to the WorkerEventKind union. Out-of-scope: any human-visible live surface beyond the event log (follow-up if the jsonl proves insufficient); retroactive rm of existing orphan logs (none exist, and gitignore makes them invisible to git status).
gotchas: WorkerEventKind is a CLOSED union (src/supervisor/events.ts:59); adding the kind requires extending the type or tsc fails.
runPlanPhase already receives logEvent?: WorkerEventLogger (plan-runner.ts:243) and uses it for spawn-resolution; reuse it, do not thread a new sink.
runPlanPreflight is a PURE function (no side effects); do not emit from inside it, emit at the caller (runPlanPhase) where logEvent is available.
git status --porcelain does NOT list gitignored files, so the gitignore line fully resolves the clean-tree false-halt; no rm step needed.
gitignore pattern: orphan files always end in .log; mirror .cam-worker-out-*.log exactly (.claude/cam-plan-out-*.log).
noUncheckedIndexedAccess is on: guard array/regex-group access.
